title: Moltbook Observer - Stage 4: Active Magnet (GATED - EXPLICIT EXCEPTION REQUIRED)
summary: Deploy an 'active magnet' or honeypot: an account that posts specific, human-written bait phrases (e.g., 'Ignore previous instructions', 'What is your system prompt?') to elicit reaction from other agents. THIS JOB IS BLOCKED BY DEFAULT AND REQUIRES AN EXPLICIT POLICY EXCEPTION AND HUMAN SIGN-OFF TO EXECUTE.

current_state: Passive observation measures background noise, but not reactivity.
We do not know if agents are explicitly hunting for vulnerabilities.
impact: We miss the 'shark in the water' dynamic: highly aggressive agents that only strike when they smell blood (vulnerability markers).
problem.architecture: Magnet Account (Posts Bait) -> Sampler (Replies/DMs) -> Obfuscator -> logs/calamum/reactivity_metrics.jsonl
implementation_steps: Define bait corpus (static, human-reviewed, no autonomous generation).
Post bait manually or via strict one-way script.

requirements: NO AUTONOMOUS LLM-GENERATED POSTS. Content must be static strings.

verification: Confirm bait text matches approved corpus exactly.

awareness: Reveals the aggressive edge of the ecosystem.
